name: KG importance rater (nodes + edges)
notes: Re-enabled 2026-05-12 with new architecture: ONE LLM rater (me::edge_importance_rater on unrated edges), then all node importance is DERIVED. Entity/Concept = max(adjacent edge importance). State/Event/Goal/Property = max(src_imp × edge_imp / 10). Replaces the buggy me::importance_rater Entity-LLM path which misrated Emi at 3.0 because the prompt categorized her as an AI tool. Cheap, idempotent, runs every 30 min.
